conversionProtection.busy: CONVERSION_BUSY rejects before creating upload files; retry only after current preview completes
conversionProtection.resource: CONVERSION_RESOURCE_LIMIT means converter exited its bounded-memory protection; no import occurred
conversionProtection.timeout: CONVERSION_TIMEOUT means converter exceeded its deadline and was terminated; no import occurred
conversionProtection.scope: Bounded child memory and global preview concurrency; not a claim of a separate operating-system cgroup.

historyCutoff.firstMcpDateAbsent: Null remains null, upload allowed only for dates strictly before current Asia/Shanghai calendar date; account/date overlap remains rejected.
historyCutoff.confirmation: First MCP context must remain identical to preview, including null; a newly appearing MCP day requires a new preview. Transaction rechecks cutoff and no existing version before insertion.

contextDates.manualHistoryDates: Sorted exact ISO dates from verified CURRENT MANUAL_HISTORY database pointers, including zero-row complete days; not derived from upload records. Gaps remain gaps.
contextDates.existingDates: Sorted exact ISO dates with any existing database input version, including machine/manual and non-current versions; these dates cannot be overwritten by history upload.
contextDates.failure: Unavailable database metadata fails the context request; never substitute empty arrays for unknown dates.

uploadSlot.scope: One unresolved file per project, checked inside the global preview semaphore before creating a new upload directory.
uploadSlot.occupied: UPLOAD_SLOT_OCCUPIED when a same-project record is nonterminal, retains its source, or still has upload.xlsx. Other projects with readable records do not block.
uploadSlot.corrupt: UPLOAD_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE blocks new preview regardless of untrusted project identity; context blockedReason reports this and keeps readable records visible. No automatic cleanup.
uploadSlot.legacy: Multiple old unresolved records remain visible; the user explicitly discards each eligible record before a new preview.
uploadSlot.discard: Only PREVIEW_READY or VALIDATION_FAILED with no confirmation, progress or saved version may discard. UPLOAD_DISCARD_UNSAFE for interrupted/partial/imported/verification/cleanup states; resume and permanent facts/evidence remain intact. Running tasks reject UPLOAD_BUSY. Replacement is explicit discard then preview, never implicit overwrite.

receiveFailure: Input-stream IOException produces VALIDATION_FAILED / UPLOAD_RECEIVE_FAILED with the retained partial copy's actual size/hash, no conversion/import. The user refreshes records and explicitly discards before reupload; other projects remain usable. Unwritable storage still fails closed, not silently repaired.
writeGuard: Explicit local-history write opt-in; loopback Host/Origin and X-SCSJ-History-Write: 1. No authentication/public access claim.

progress.active: boolean; current service worker is executing this upload
progress.completedDays: Completed dates in current stage, resets when entering final verification. Not whole-job percent.
progress.startedAt: ISO instant for current execution attempt
progress.updatedAt: ISO instant of latest persisted progress

progressNotes: GET view/context reads atomically persisted snapshots without waiting for the write lock. Mutations still require the exclusive upload lock.
Inactive persisted running states are presented as INTERRUPTED; explicit confirmation is required to retry, never automatic import.
Upload transport byte progress is a client measurement. Conversion has no row-level progress and must be shown indeterminately until preview response; transport 100% is not validation success.
COMPLETED alone means import, final independent verification and source-copy cleanup all succeeded. Network errors mean result unknown, not server cancellation.

deduplication.duplicateRowsSkipped: Number of earlier duplicate rows excluded; final row replaces the whole normalized fact, never sums or fills missing values. Preview hash binds this policy and count; account/project are fixed by server context. Existing database dates remain rejected.

recordTimes.createdAt: ISO instant written into immutable preview for new uploads; legacy views use preview file modification time without rewriting evidence
recordTimes.completedAt: ISO instant or null; legacy completed records use progress.updatedAt, then state file modification time
recordTimes.order: Context uploads newest first by completedAt when present, otherwise createdAt; uploadId only breaks equal-time ties

contextWarnings.meaning: One generic warning for each unreadable upload record; readable records remain viewable and safely discardable. New previews are blocked because the corrupt identity is untrusted. Never expose its project/account/upload identity or paths. No deletion or implicit repair.

interruptionRecovery: If a database day committed before its versionId reached state.json, explicit retry may recover only the CURRENT version matching this project's account/date, MANUAL_HISTORY source, schema/catalog/data version, content hash, exact permanent upload evidence paths/sizes/hashes and all rows. Independent verification remains mandatory. Another upload, even with identical rows, is not recoverable; overlap remains rejected.
notes: Server resolves identity, configuration revision, first successful MCP date and existing dates.
Preview hash binds immutable preview and per-day facts hashes. Confirmations are mandatory before normalized import evidence exists.
Each day uses a new transaction and independent verification. Retry verifies successful days without overwrite.
Only the exact upload.xlsx copy is eligible for deletion after hash/size checks; normalized evidence and facts remain.
Cancel never rolls back already imported days or deletes machine evidence.
Validation failure is HTTP 200 View with diagnostic, null start/end and valid previewHash for cancellation.
